# openinfra_feature_group (Resource)

An online feature store for real-time inference (SageMaker Feature Store) — a per-group Valkey + an API service serving PutRecord/GetRecord for millisecond feature lookups.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `record_identifier` (String) The feature that uniquely identifies a record (the primary key), e.g. `customer_id`.

### Optional

- `event_time` (String) The feature carrying the record's event time; the latest write wins.
- `features` (Attributes List) The feature schema (advisory — the online store is schemaless key/value). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--features))
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) Optional per-record TTL in the online store (seconds since last write). Unset = no expiry.

### Read-Only

- `endpoint` (String) The feature-store API URL (PutRecord/GetRecord).
- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.

<a id="nestedatt--features"></a>
### Nested Schema for `features`

Required:

- `name` (String)

Optional:

- `type` (String) Value type. One of: `string`, `integral`, `fractional`.
